 The Search for the World’s Catchiest Ad 
 Enter now See the rules 
 We're launching a $100K creative competition challenging top creators worldwide to make a complete ad, visuals, voice, music, and sound, made entirely with AI in ElevenCreative. 
 How it works Get set to win 
 Enter now See the prizes 
 Invent a fictional brand and make a 15-45 second ad for it. The catch: it needs a jingle so good it sticks. People should be singing it the next morning.
 1. Invent a fictional brand 
 Any product or service, any category, the weirder or more wonderful, the better. 
 2. Make an ad with an original jingle
 One video, between 0:15 and 0:45. Your ad must feature the product's name, image, and logo. It must include the competition watermark - download it from the "Rules" section below. 
 3. Share & Sumit
 Enter solo or as a team, as many times as you like. Submissions close 1 November 11:59pm PST. 
 Need a starting point? We made a few products up to get you going. 
 See the rules 
 <PHONE>-DUMPLING 
 A 24-hour hotline that delivers hot dumplings when the craving hits.
 A 24-hour hotline that delivers hot dumplings when the craving hits.
 Objection! 
 Your personal on-call legal cover for everyday people.
 Your personal on-call legal cover for everyday people.
 Bolt running shoes 
 Performance running shoes designed to make you feel faster from the first step.
 Performance running shoes designed to make you feel faster from the first step.
 The Rules
 Your jingle must be created in ElevenCreative, no exceptions. 
 Your jingle must be created in ElevenCreative, no exceptions. You'll submit the original audio file alongside your finished ad, and we verify every entry. Beyond that, use whatever tools you like: edit in Studio or bring your own workflow. But how fully you use ElevenCreative's toolkit (voice, music, sound design, video) is factored into judging.The more you make in ElevenCreative, the better.
 Finalists may be asked to provide raw generation files or project access to verify their entry.
 Follow the brief
 Every entry needs an original jingle written for this competition. No existing songs, covers, or reworks of tracks that already exist. The jingle should be a core piece of the ad. 
 Ad duration
 One video, between 0:15 and 0:45. Entries outside that range won't be judged.
 Use the product
 Your ad must feature your chosen product's name, image, and logo.
 New work only
 Entries must be created specifically for this competition. Anything previously published, posted, or submitted elsewhere is ineligible.
 Watermark
 Your final ad must carry the official ElevenCreative contest watermark. See placement guidance and the downloadable watermark here . Add the official competition watermark in the bottom-right corner of the final video and every social post. Submissions without it will not be accepted.
 Your work, your rights
 Everything in your entry must be yours to use, no copyrighted characters, brands, logos, or likenesses of real people without permission. By entering, you grant ElevenLabs the right to share and promote your ad across our channels, with credit.
 Agencies & studios welcome
 This isn't just for solo creators. Agencies and studios can enter with a fictional product – or a real client product, with the client's written permission as proof. Same rules apply: original jingle, 15–45 seconds, made with ElevenCreative.
 Any team size
 Go solo or bring collaborators, there is no limit. Prizes go to the team leader, who can choose how to distribute to their team.
 Deadlines
 Submissions open October 5 and close November 1. Your music link and social posts must stay accessible through the judging period. Winners announced November 10 on X.
 Keep it fun
 Any genre, any style. Offensive, graphic, or explicit content is out.
 Submitting your ad
 Post your ad publicly on at least two of: X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube. Every post must include the hashtags #TheWorldsCatchiestAd and #ElevenCreativeCompetitionVol1 , and tag @elevencreative and @elevenlabs where the platform allows. Posts must stay live through the judging period.
 Then fill out the submission form with your post links and your Studio project link.
 Read the fine print
 For the full competition rules, visit our official rules page .
 $100,000 up for grabs across eleven winners.
 See the rules 
 Winners announced 10 November 9:30am PST
 Grand Prize – $50,000 The catchiest ad of the competition. One winner, judged on the strength of the jingle, the craft of the ad, and how well it answers the brief.
 Second Place – $20,000 Awarded to the runner-up entry.
 Third Place – $10,000 Awarded to the third-place entry.
 Finalists (4th–11th) – $2,500 each Award to eight more entries that stood out.
 The Bonus All eleven winners get something money can't buy: a seat at the table. Receive an exclusive 30-minute 1:1 with ElevenLabs' Creative Production team. We're scaling fast and always looking for great creative talent.

 The ‘four Cs’  criteria
 Catchiness
 The one that matters most. Is the jingle stuck in our heads? A great ad here isn't just watched, it’s got people humming it for days after.
 Concept
 Context stitching keeps pacing and delivery steady across a script of any length. A full audiobook sounds like a single take from the first page to the last.
 Craft
 How well you used ElevenCreative to make it. Voice, music, sound design, video, the more of the toolkit your ad puts to work, and the better it's used, the stronger it on craft her
 Cohesion
 Does it hold together as a cohesive ad? Product, jingle, visuals, and voice working as one piece, not a jingle that feels separate to the ad itself. 
 Submit by 1st Nov
 Before you submit your ad, post your ad publicly on at least two of the following platforms: X, Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube (bonus points for all four). Then, fill out the submission form with your post links and your Studio project link. Posts must stay live through the judging period.
